# Horizontal Hole Shape

Large round holes lying across the print direction, which sag without a teardrop top.

<figure markdown="span">
![Horizontal Hole Shape: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/horizontal-hole-teardrop-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Horizontal Hole Shape: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/horizontal-hole-teardrop-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Round holes across the print direction, which need a teardrop top to print without sagging.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Low |

## Values

This rule has no number to meet: when it finds the problem, it reports it as the error or warning set here.

Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | If detected | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | Warning | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Sagging hole top: `{feature}` (`{size}`) is a round hole lying across the print direction. Its top has to bridge, so it sags and the hole comes out oval. Give it a teardrop or diamond top (a 45° point) so it prints without support.
!!! failure "Error"

    Sagging hole top: `{feature}` (`{size}`) is a round hole lying across the print direction. Its top has to bridge, so it sags and the hole comes out oval. Give it a teardrop or diamond top (a 45° point) so it prints without support.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
